watchdog_audit.script_full:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fail-closed watchdog for the GP-MSF 24e run launched 2026-10-13 (outside queue).
# Mirrors queue_gpmsf.sh run_owned: exception/OOM -> stop; ep6 stop-loss; ep12-16 report.
cd /home/lurui/workspace/R4Det
source .envrc
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5,6,7
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
WD=/data/lurui/work_dirs/fgfull_N4_no2d_igdr_2x4_24e_gpmsf_seed0
B0=/data/lurui/work_dirs/fgfull_N4_no2d_igdr_2x4_24e_seed0
LOG=$WD/train_gpmsf.log
WLOG=$WD/watchdog_gpmsf.log
PGID=3551130
CHECK=(python me_rssm/sanity/gpmsf_run_checks.py)
say(){ echo "[watchdog] $(date -u '+%F %T') $*" >> "$WLOG"; }
stop_owned(){ kill -TERM -- "-$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 20; kill -KILL -- "-$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
say "armed pgid=$PGID"
early=0; mature=0
while kill -0 -- "-$PGID" 2>/dev/null; do
  if grep -Eqi 'CAUGHT AN EXCEPTION|Traceback \(most recent call last\)|CUDA out of memory' "$LOG"; then
    say 'EXCEPTION/OOM detected; stopping owned session'; stop_owned; say 'STOPPED_EXCEPTION'; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$early" -eq 0 ]; then
    if "${CHECK[@]}" ready --work-dir "$WD" --expected-epochs 6 > "$WD/.wd_ready6.log" 2>&1; then
      if "${CHECK[@]}" curve --work-dir "$WD" --b0 "$B0" --window 1-6 --early-stop --live \
            --out "$WD/gpmsf_ep6_report.json" >> "$WLOG" 2>&1; then
        early=1; say 'ep1-6 complete; no >2 AP task harm'
      else
        say 'EP6 STOP-LOSS TRIPPED (task harm or evidence failure)'; stop_owned; say 'STOPPED_EP6'; exit 2
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$mature" -eq 0 ] && "${CHECK[@]}" ready --work-dir "$WD" --expected-epochs 16 > "$WD/.wd_ready16.log" 2>&1; then
    if "${CHECK[@]}" curve --work-dir "$WD" --b0 "$B0" --window 12-16 --live \
          --out "$WD/gpmsf_ep16_report.json" >> "$WLOG" 2>&1; then
      mature=1; say 'ep12-16 complete; report written; training continues to ep24'
    else
      say 'ep12-16 live evidence not ready/invalid; will retry'
    fi
  fi
  sleep 60
done
say 'trainer process group exited'
if [ -f "$WD/epoch_24.pth" ]; then
  "${CHECK[@]}" curve --work-dir "$WD" --b0 "$B0" --window 1-6 --early-stop \
     --out "$WD/gpmsf_ep6_report.json" >> "$WLOG" 2>&1 || say 'final ep6 recheck failed'
  "${CHECK[@]}" curve --work-dir "$WD" --b0 "$B0" --window 12-16 --expected-epochs 24 \
     --out "$WD/gpmsf_full_curve_report.json" >> "$WLOG" 2>&1 || say 'final full-curve report failed'
  say 'DONE: epoch_24.pth present; reports written'
else
  say 'NO epoch_24.pth; stopped short (review required)'
fi
